prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Katy, Texas. Injury: back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1120; do not mention it.)
text: I was driving north on the main road in Katy, Texas, and had stopped at the light before making my left turn into the shopping center entrance. When the light turned green, I started into the intersection and waited for the oncoming traffic to clear. A vehicle coming from the opposite direction did not slow down, and it struck the front driver's side of my car as I was completing the turn. The impact spun my vehicle partly around, and both airbags did not deploy, though the seatbelt locked hard across my chest. I got out and checked the scene, and I immediately noticed pain in my lower back that has gotten worse since then. I was taken to urgent care the same day, where I was told I had a back strain and was given instructions for rest and follow-up visits. I am providing this statement so the claim can be processed.
